findings.title: Possessed wealth as a failed substitute

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the verse as a failed rescue mechanism at the crisis point, not merely as a general statement that wealth has limits.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that his wealth does not benefit him when he falls. The finding adds the tested stand-in function and does not claim that every occurrence of wealth or availing carries this relation.

epistemic.reason: The focus construction and trusted candidate are direct, while legacy HFT traces supply the wider return with explicit qualification rather than lexical certainty.

friction_notes: The docket readiness block is recorded in the packet, but the authoring policy makes all 18 parseable HFT records visible; exact anchored HFT traces were retained with legacy qualification rather than suppressed.
The focus word alignment resolves all seven analysis entries. The primary floor is direct: the verse states that his wealth gives him no benefit when he falls.

The packet has no selected context-unit projections. HFT context coordinates and exact Arabic anchors were therefore used only in attributed mode; unresolved context branches receive null gloss and facet fields, as required.
Connection records supply target Arabic and relation notes but no target morphology. They are used as corroborating triggers and not as permission to invent target lexical analysis.

The unanchored HFT summaries were reviewed individually. Exact duplicates of anchored possession-to-purification and noncompensatory findings are represented; the remaining summaries are rejected because they lack an exact carrier-trigger-focus-return chain or combine multiple claims.

The supplied publication candidate for the combined stone/heavy-gait/wealth-weight image is explicitly marked reject. Its stone component and the separate furnace and bounded stone findings remain independently accounted for.

The 176 connection rows add many redundant failed-wealth parallels and several no-value or broad topical rows. No additional uncandidate activation produced a materially distinct carrier-trigger-payoff relation beyond the retained findings; the rows were not exhaustively emitted as negatives.
